name: dated-availability-question-then-confirm
pins: A question about *when* is a third kind of answer to a proposal, and the confirmation verdict now has a member for it. Live, four date-scoped questions in one conversation — "between august 5th and 10th", "week after next", "after august 3rd", "more slots after august 10th" — were all filed as non-answers and met the same frozen re-ask, because the enum had nowhere else to put them. The phrase now rides to `resolve_date`, which is the only thing permitted to turn words into dates, and the times in that window come back. Nothing about the pinned rule moves: the proposal is still held, still un-answered, and still bookable only by an exact token or the button.

turns.message: I need a cardiology appointment next week
